subject: dplyr: collect() function (most of the times...) takes ages to execute

messages.author: 559788c27381a3f3
messages.subject: dplyr: collect() function (most of the times...) takes ages to execute
parts:
I encountered a problem with dplyr collecting data from an SQLite database. This database is approximately 5.5 gb. In this db there is just one table that contains all the data. When I try to fetch data (650,000 rows, 24 columns) with the collect() function it takes ages most of the time. BUT sometimes it just takes 15 seconds. Very strange...

The script I am using looks like this:
my_db <- src_sqlite("database.sqlite3", create = FALSE)
datacollect <- tbl(my_db, "my_table")
datacollect <- filter(datacollect, column1==3)
datacollect <- collect(datacollect)

I execute this script on a virtual windows machine where I installed R and RStudio. Is it possible that this machine  causes somehow this problem? I really have no clue where to look. Any ideas anyone? Most appreciated!
